fluff.overview: Drawing veterans from the Com Guards, recruits from the Free Worlds League, and volunteers from Protectorate worlds, the Word of Blake Militia assembled infantry formations whose quality varied but whose equipment was consistently first-rate. Mechanized wheeled Level I formations used wheeled APCs for efficient patrol and garrison operations on developed worlds within the Protectorate. Their lower maintenance burden compared to tracked or hover transports made them the most common mechanized infantry type in the Word of Blake Militia's order of battle. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
